📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: August 1, 2026)

On Saturday, August 1, I attended the renovation ceremony for Hanno Kawara Stage Square.

I look forward to seeing this newly renovated stage used even more fully—as a place where people can enjoy time with nature and the clear river, and where businesses can pursue various new ideas and ventures.
